sections.title: Contemporary African Music
sections.description: Come to know Africa's history, culture, and peoples through the study of its contemporary music. We examine the continent in eight "regions": North, Southern, East, Central, and West Africa; the Sahel, the Islands around the continent, and diasporic routes of contemporary musicians. Each region has its own music playlist.
